newsitem.title: INDIA: China's Jiang begins visit to India.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiang begins visit to India.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin arrived in India on Thursday for an historic visit aimed at strengthening ties between the world's two most populous nations, officials said.
Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma welcomed Jiang, the first ever Chinese president to visit India, in a brief ceremony at the presidential palace in New Delhi.
Hours before Jiang arrived, Tibetan demonstrators demanding China leave their homeland held a noisy protest in the capital.
More than 600 protesters burnt an effigy of Jiang and set fire to the Chinese flag at a Tibetan refugee camp in the city.
To keep delicate bilateral relations on track, both India and China were expected to avoid dwelling on the contentious issue of Tibet during official talks.
Indian officials say one step towards improving ties could be a troop reduction along their disputed Himalayan frontier, as well as spurs to trade and investment.
